payment.config.account: Stable merchant account ID (not a key)
payment.config.credentials_help: Credentials are write-only. Leave every credential blank to retain existing values; supply the complete set when rotating. The account identity and environment cannot change. Never use a secret as the account ID. WeChat currently implements live Native transport; sandbox transport is unavailable.
payment.config.enable: Explicitly enable this merchant (requires valid configuration and implemented entry point)
payment.config.intro: Disabled by default. Only implemented, merchant-approved entry points are offered. Enabling configuration does not establish official sandbox or live transaction acceptance. Aggregated payment and tax invoicing require a dedicated adapter.
payment.config.invalid_limits: Enter complete positive integer minimum/maximum amounts and a three-letter settlement currency. Maximum must not be below minimum.
payment.config.limits_help: Use integer minor units (two decimals for CNY/USD). A currency without confirmed limits cannot accept new payments. Field precision is not a merchant allowance. Confirm contract limits with the provider. Settlement currency is evidence only and never triggers conversion.

support.attachment_limit: Up to 3 attachments, totaling 500 KB. Plain text, PNG, JPEG and PDF files are provided as downloads.
support.author: Ticket author
support.empty: No tickets yet. Submit an issue using the form above.
support.help.ai.body: Remote platform and bring-your-own-key models receive the mail content you explicitly select. Only an authenticated Roundcube mailbox can authorize its own mail context; panel accounts cannot access other mailboxes. Local models do not send content to platform model providers.
support.help.ai.title: AI models and content disclosure
support.help.archive_recall.body: Archives are retained indefinitely by default. Only the tenant owner may grant time-limited content, export or retention permissions. Legal holds take precedence. Retention cleanup requires preview confirmation, followed by soft deletion and a 30-day physical-deletion delay. Local recall affects only copies controlled by this system, not externally delivered mail.
support.help.archive_recall.title: Archives, retention and local recall
support.help.dns.body: Verify domain ownership first, then configure MX, SPF, DKIM and DMARC as shown on the domain page. Paid mail delivery requires verification. Recheck after DNS propagation.
support.help.dns.title: Configure domains and DNS
support.help.renewal.body: Renewals retain the remaining paid term. Monthly, quarterly and annual CNY/USD prices are separate, with no automatic conversion. Cancellation preserves service through the final paid term; renewed service requires payment.
support.help.renewal.title: Renewal and cancellation
support.help.trial_refund.body: Each tenant may receive one trial after domain verification. Trials do not stack or replace paid entitlement. Refunds require platform approval of amount and entitlement timing. Coupons are not restored automatically; audited reissue is available.
support.help.trial_refund.title: Trials, coupons and refunds
support.help.unsubscribe.body: Marketing lists require explicit consent. The email link opens a confirmation page; standard one-click unsubscribe is also supported. Once unsubscribe commits, no new send attempt is authorized. Already in-flight delivery may still complete. Importing contacts does not remove unsubscribe or complaint suppressions.
support.help.unsubscribe.title: Marketing consent and unsubscribe
support.intro: Tickets contain only the support content you submit. Support access does not grant mailbox or archive access. Do not submit passwords or keys.
support.subject: Subject
calendar.admin.title: Billing calendar verification
calendar.admin.intro: Verify missing legacy facts once from reliable evidence. This never rewrites paid terms. New purchases establish their calendar automatically.
calendar.admin.current_timezone: Current business timezone: {{timezone}}. This is not proof of the historic billing timezone.
calendar.admin.readonly: The first billing timezone and first paid timestamp are immutable. The current date anchor can change only through a legitimate expired-service reactivation.
calendar.admin.legacy: Legacy paid history exists without a verified calendar. Existing entitlements remain unchanged; a platform operator must verify the original facts before a new quote.
calendar.admin.timestamp_help: Enter an RFC3339 timestamp with an explicit offset, for example 2024-01-31T09:00:00+08:00. Do not infer the original timezone from current settings.
calendar.admin.confirm: I verified these facts with reliable records. This one-time action fixes the first billing timezone and does not alter paid periods.
calendar.admin.saved: Calendar verified and audited. Existing paid periods were preserved.
calendar.admin.automatic: No legacy paid calendar needs review. The first completed commercial purchase establishes its calendar automatically; free gifts and trials do not define it.
error.BILLING_CALENDAR_ALREADY_SET: This calendar already exists and cannot be overwritten. Refresh to read the verified facts.
error.BILLING_CALENDAR_INVALID: The configured billing timezone is unavailable. Ask the platform to correct it.
error.BILLING_CALENDAR_REVIEW_NOT_REQUIR: This tenant has no protected legacy paid history to verify. The first completed purchase creates its calendar.
error.BILLING_CALENDAR_REVIEW_REQUIRED: The historical billing calendar needs platform verification before a new quote. Existing paid service is unchanged.
error.BILLING_CALENDAR_CHANGED: The billing calendar or first-payment timezone changed. Request a fresh quote.
page.billing.calendar: Billing calendar: {{timezone}}. Continuous renewals retain the original day and wall time.
page.billing.calendar_provisional: The first or resumed full cycle starts when paid service is activated. Its date anchor is established then; the first billing timezone stays frozen.
error.MIGRATION_ENTITLEMENT_PRESERVED: Migrated existing mail service has no automatic expiry. Purchase a commercial plan to start a new paid period; scheduled cancellation or replacement is unavailable.
billing_lifecycle.migration_preserved: Migrated existing mail service · no automatic expiry
billing_lifecycle.migration_purchase: Existing mail service is preserved. A commercial purchase starts its own complete period immediately; AI and marketing require separately configured limits.
error.MIGRATION_ENTITLEMENT_EXISTS: Existing migrated mail service is already preserved; a trial is unnecessary.
